name: claudekit
description: Free, tested Claude Code kits from Claudekit.ai, an independent community project (not affiliated with Anthropic). Each kit has a recipe page with its test level.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Status line with model, context use and your 5-hour and weekly plan usage (Pro and Max).

plugins.name: safe-mode
plugins.description: PreToolUse guard that denies or asks before destructive shell commands. Fails closed when jq is missing.

plugins.name: token-diet
plugins.description: Audits CLAUDE.md files, always-on rules, skills and MCP servers, then suggests documented ways to trim context.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Reviews your branch diff against its base with a fixed checklist and writes REVIEW.md. Works offline.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Drafts release notes from git log between two refs, grouped by Conventional Commit type.
